eventDetail.scope: The BVUCON is an international conference on vision for interdisciplinary science, technology, and applications, bringing together researchers, academicians, industry professionals, innovators, policymakers, and students to present and share their cutting-edge research, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions that contribute to sustainable development through interdisciplinary collaboration. The conference welcomes original research papers, review articles, industrial case studies, and application-oriented contributions in the fields of science, engineering, technology, healthcare, management, environmental sciences, and allied disciplines. Six multidisciplinary tracks will make up the conference: Artificial Intelligence and Intelligent Systems; Smart Infrastructure and Advanced Manufacturing; Renewable Energy and Environmental Sustainability; AI in Healthcare; Innovation in Education and Society; and Emerging Technologies and Interdisciplinary Applications.
